d:
Pesh hai film charas ka behad khubsurat aur sadabhar gana "aaja teri yad aaee, jise apni madhur aavaz men lata mangeshkar aur mohammad rafi ne sajaya hai.
film: charas (1976)
gayak: lata mangeshkar, mohammad rafi
git: aaja teri yad aaee
Agar aapko purane hindi filmi git aur sadabhar nagme pasand hain, to is khubsurat git ko zarur sunen aur apne priyajnon ke sath sheyar karen.
